The FloPlast 92.5° round offset bend is a durable uPVC downpipe fitting designed to navigate obstacles in external drainage systems. This white 68mm offset bend is ideal for adapting existing round downpipes around architectural features on residential and commercial buildings, ensuring efficient rainwater runoff. It offers a practical and easy-to-install solution for both new build and refurbishment projects, providing a reliable connection. The uPVC construction ensures longevity and its compatibility with most major manufacturers makes it a versatile choice for plumbers and general builders.
